title: kbext.py verify calls each extender a group configured with its point's sample inputs and checks the answer's shape, so a group's CI catches a break at pull time
goal: Each point in kbext.SURFACE carries sample inputs and a shape check of its answer. kbext.py verify --root WS loads every extender the settings layers name (a load failure or KBEXT_REQUIRES mismatch counts as a failure), calls it with its point's samples in a child process with a timeout, and prints one line per extender, ok or what failed with the point, the module and the layer; exit 0 all ok or none configured, 1 a failure, 2 bad arguments. extending.md gives the command a group's CI runs after each upstream pull.

run:
import json,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); e=d/"ext"; e.mkdir()
(e/"grp_lane.py").write_text("KBEXT_REQUIRES = \">=1.0,<2\"\ndef good(path):\n    return \"content\"\ndef bad(path):\n    return 42\n",encoding="utf-8")
s=lambda m: (d/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"extensions":{"lane":m},"extension_paths":["ext"]}),encoding="utf-8")
v=lambda: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbext.py","verify","--root",str(d)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
s("grp_lane:good"); r=v(); assert r.returncode==0 and "lane" in r.stdout, (r.stdout,r.stderr)
s("grp_lane:bad"); r=v(); assert r.returncode==1 and "lane" in r.stdout+r.stderr and "grp_lane" in r.stdout+r.stderr, (r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
